[SWS_CORE_03318] Reverse-find of character set within a StringView
⌈
A member function shall be defined for BasicString that allows reverse-searching
for any of the characters within a StringView:
size_type find_last_of(StringView sv,
size_type pos = npos) const noexcept; This function shall behave the same as the corresponding std::basic_string func-
tion from [6, the C++17 standard].
⌋
